title: About Me
text:
Outside of Work
I grew up in Wisconsin—Go Pack Go! I like to read, listen to podcasts, and puzzle (can you puzzle faster than me?). I recently took a beginner crochet class and am hooked! My favorite TV show is Survivor.
My partner Matt and I enjoy playing cribbage, listening to live music, and walking our Giant Schnauzer, Blu—short for Blugold, a nod to where we met at UW–Eau Claire.

title: Olivia Vruwink, MS CCC-SLP
text:
I am a speech-language pathologist and PhD candidate in Speech-Language-Hearing Sciences at the University of Minnesota. I am studying various aspects of rehabilitation after traumatic brain injury (TBI) under the supervision of Dr. Natalie Covington.
My research examines purpose in life, psychosocial well-being, and adjustment after traumatic brain injury, with particular attention to TBI survivor–care partner dyads.
I am also interested in community-engaged rehabilitation and the scholarship of teaching and learning in communication sciences and disorders.
